stage_a_raw:
{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "flow_variable_domain",
      "evidence": "\"each capable of handling a certain amount of electricity\" / \"maximum amount of electricity (in megawatts) that can flow\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Reals"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_definition",
      "evidence": "\"calculate the maximum amount of electricity that can be transmitted from Station 0 (the source) to Station 7\"",
      "options": [
        "maximize net flow into sink (inflow to 7 minus outflow from 7)",
        "maximize total flow leaving source (sum of flow[0,j])",
        "maximize flow on arc (0,7) only"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.35,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "maximize total flow leaving source (sum of flow[0,j])"
    },
    {
      "decision": "sink_conservation_treatment",
      "evidence": "\"ensuring that the flow through each transmission line does not exceed its capacity\" / \"From Station 7 (Destination): Can send electricity back to Station 0...\"",
      "options": [
        "no conservation at sink; allow outflow from 7 (net flow objective)",
        "no conservation at sink; force outflow from 7 to zero",
        "enforce conservation at sink (inflow == outflow)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.5,
        0.3,
        0.2
      ],
      "majority_option": "no conservation at sink; allow outflow from 7 (net flow objective)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "source_conservation_treatment",
      "evidence": "\"From Station 0 (Source): Can send electricity to Station 1...\" / \"From Station 1: Can send electricity to Station 0 (1 MW)...\"",
      "options": [
        "no conservation at source; allow inflow to 0 (net flow objective)",
        "no conservation at source; force inflow to 0 to zero",
        "enforce conservation at source (inflow == outflow)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.5,
        0.3,
        0.2
      ],
      "majority_option": "no conservation at source; allow inflow to 0 (net flow objective)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "capacity_constraint_direction",
      "evidence": "\"ensuring that the flow through each transmission line does not exceed its capacity\"",
      "options": [
        "flow[i,j] <= capacity[i,j]",
        "flow[i,j] >= capacity[i,j]",
        "flow[i,j] == capacity[i,j]"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.97,
        0.02,
        0.01
      ],
      "majority_option": "flow[i,j] <= capacity[i,j]"
    },
    {
      "decision": "arc_orientation",
      "evidence": "\"From Station 0 (Source): Can send electricity to Station 1 (9 MW)...\" / \"From Station 1: Can send electricity to Station 0 (1 MW)...\"",
      "options": [
        "directed arcs as listed (capacity[i][j] applies to i->j only)",
        "undirected edges with shared capacity (capacity[i][j] == capacity[j][i])",
        "directed arcs but capacity symmetric (use max of both directions)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "directed arcs as listed (capacity[i][j] applies to i->j only)"
    }
  ]
}
